Class InMemoryJavaClassSource

java.lang.Object
sootup.java.core.JavaSootClassSource
sootup.java.core.InMemoryJavaClassSource
All Implemented Interfaces:
SootClassSource, HasGenericSignature
public class InMemoryJavaClassSource extends JavaSootClassSource
A class source where all information is already available in memory, e.g. classes that are batchparsed (like .jimple files) or synthesized in tests.

To replace parts of an existing class source, wrap it in an OverridingJavaClassSource.

Author:
Christian Brüggemann, Hasitha Rajapakse, Ashik Mogasavara Ravikumar

      public InMemoryJavaClassSource(@NonNull AnalysisInputLocation srcNamespace, @NonNull Path sourcePath, @NonNull ClassType classType, @Nullable JavaClassType superClass, @NonNull Set<JavaClassType> interfaces, @Nullable JavaClassType outerClass, @NonNull Set<JavaSootField> sootFields, @NonNull Set<JavaSootMethod> sootMethods, @NonNull Position position, @NonNull EnumSet<ClassModifier> modifiers, @NonNull Iterable<AnnotationUsage> annotations, @NonNull Iterable<AnnotationUsage> methodAnnotations, @Nullable Iterable<AnnotationUsage> fieldAnnotations, @NonNull JavaClassFileMetadata classFileMetadata)
      Creates a fully resolved class source with immutable source and nesting attributes.
      Parameters:
      srcNamespace - the input location containing the class
      sourcePath - the path to the classfile
      classType - the class type
      superClass - the superclass, or null if absent
      interfaces - the implemented interfaces
      outerClass - the outer class, or null if absent
      sootFields - the fields
      sootMethods - the methods
      position - the source position
      modifiers - the class modifiers
      annotations - the class annotations
      methodAnnotations - the method annotations
      fieldAnnotations - the field annotations
      classFileMetadata - the source and nesting attributes
